scope: Native DSP-only MainCalibration target: 24 states x 3 scenarios x 3 sample rates; no SDK, plug-in processor or hosted Reason run; no audio files.

protocol.normal: Five seconds, 20-note phrase, velocity80, Linear curve, retained full tails, stereo energy RMS, no normalization

frozen_reference_derivation.factory_rms_anchor: arithmetic mean of three measured RMS dBFS values, rounded to four decimals, then shifted -.10dB
frozen_reference_derivation.factory_peak_center: midpoint of three-rate measured min/max, original window widths retained, then shifted -.10dB
frozen_reference_derivation.full_vca_exceptions: Removed flags for Soft Yarn Nocturne and Kalimba Thumb Lullaby; both now authored below Volume1.

observed_uniform_scale_check.note: Stress overrides preset Volume to1; unchanged stress results are expected.

earlier_candidate_test.driver_post_run_guard: After CTest exited0, its final watched-source assertion failed because the parent had already replaced FactoryPresets.h with the intended final−25.95 bank. This earlier iteration is diagnostic only; the final run binds the replacement header and all eight watched inputs remain unchanged.

retained_gates.gain_reduction_gate: Not part of this test. Separate wrapper ordinary-playing validation remains required.

build.configuration: Release, native arch, MAREMBA_BUILD_PLUGIN=OFF, MAREMBA_BUILD_TOOLS=OFF, MAREMBA_BUILD_UNIVERSAL=OFF
build.warning: Initial CMake configure warned numpy/scipy/mpmath were unavailable to its chosen Python; generator/measurement Python checks were not registered. The three selected C++ MainCalibration tests were registered and passed.

limitations: The secondary v80 phrase does not establish the primary v100 single/pair level score.
No actual Reason VU meter reading or VU-offset qualification is claimed.
No Main gain, MainVolume law, factory table or production DSP edit was made by this test update.
Frozen-output reference regeneration is intentional after authored VCA and Kalimba decay changes; it is not an independent guarantee of tonal quality or gain-reduction behavior.
